resolvedStack: React Native / Expo + Next.js 14 Web Preview + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Prisma
name: AgroSense Crop Scout
description: AgroSense Crop Scout is a cross-platform mobile agronomy app for monitoring field plots, soil moisture telemetry, irrigation schedules, and pest scouting reports backed by Prisma PostgreSQL.

metadata.name: AgroSense Crop Scout
metadata.description: Mobile agronomy app for field plots, soil telemetry, and pest scouting reports.

files.description: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma 5, NextAuth v4, Zod, lucide-react, react-icons.
Expo app configuration for AgroSense Crop Scout.
PostgreSQL Prisma schema with Role, PlotHealth, AlertPriority enums and User, FieldPlot, SoilReading, PestReport models.
Shared TypeScript interfaces for FieldPlot, SoilReading, PestReport.
Root layout with SessionProvider, Navbar, and Footer.
Mobile landing screen for AgroSense Crop Scout.
Mobile agronomy dashboard displaying plot health KPIs, soil moisture cards, and recent pest alerts.
Field plots directory with health badges and add-plot modal.
Pest scouting report list and submission form.
Client hook fetching /api/plots on mount via useEffect with safe array fallback.
Client hook fetching /api/scouting on mount via useEffect with safe array fallback.
GET and POST API route for FieldPlot records.
GET and POST API route for PestReport records.
